title: A booking over XML, step by step
text: What a broker sends and what we answer, message by message, in the test console (sandbox: nothing real is booked).

title: The test console sends real broker messages to this channel, in the sandbox: nothing is booked for real.
text: Pick a message on the left, then click Send.

title: Ping: the broker checks the connection. The answer says Success and repeats their text.
Availability & rates: the broker’s search — branch, dates and driver age.
text: Our answer lists each car group with its price, extras, the cancellation terms and an offer number.

title: Book: the broker books an offer. Our answer confirms it with our reservation number (RSV-…).
text: Sending the same broker reference again returns the same booking, never a second one.

title: Retrieve: the broker reads the booking back with our reservation number.
Modify: the broker changes the dates. The price is worked out again and the car is checked as still free.
Cancel: the booking is cancelled under your cancellation terms and the car is free again.
“Run full booking flow” runs all of these in one click — the quickest check after any change.
